name: Yardi Deal Manager
description: Connect your Yardi Deal Manager data to Claude and interact with it conversationally. Ask questions about deals, tenants, properties, vacancies and CRM records and get clear answers instantly. Built for leasing teams, brokers, asset managers and property owners who need timely, reliable insights to make confident decisions. All interactions operate within the security and governance controls of your existing Yardi configuration.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Yardi Deal Manager to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yardi Deal Manager to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dmmcp.virtuoso.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yardi Deal Manager MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yardi Deal Manager lists 14 MCP tools, including dm_deals_get_active_deals, dm_deals_get_deal_activities, dm_deals_get_deal_economics, dm_deals_get_deal_id, dm_deals_get_deal_information, dm_deals_get_deal_stage_history, dm_object_get_object_detail, dm_pendingtask_get_pending_tasks, dm_proposals_get_proposal_comparison, dm_proposals_get_proposals, dm_reports_get_activity_report, and dm_reports_get_leasing_activity_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yardi Deal Manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Yardi Deal Manager in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Yardi Deal Manager MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yardi Deal Manager requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yardi Deal Manager is developed by Yardi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
